marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF513EB 3/8 in. ratchet delivers 45 ft-lb torque from a 20 V Max battery with 1.3 Ah capacity. Its metal housing and black rubber ergonomic handle provide a compact, tool‑free chuck design, while the variable speed trigger switch allows operation from 0 to 200 RPM. The 7‑1/2 in. length and 3‑1/2 in. width fit tight spaces, and the 85 dB sound level keeps noise manageable.
